lead: Do projects made with the original Access plug-in open with TI Revive? Two Ableton Live 11 projects were saved with the original on Windows 10 (one with the VST3, one with the VST2): parts 1-3 Fimplex HS, Acidia AV, Alead BC, a MIDI clip, Cutoff automation on part 1 and Reso on part 2 (Easy page). Update: release 0.8.24 failed PW1 (Live 11 restores only the exact class id, E221). Test build 0.8.25b registers the plug-in a second time under the original's id as "TI Revive Virus Control (original projects)"; with it PW1 and PW2 passed on the Windows 11 VM, PW3 (VST2) fails as expected (E222). Now the Mac and the real PC with 0.8.25b. Mark each item, note anything different, then copy the results at the bottom into the chat.
rules: Order: Windows 11 VM first (Claude moves the Virus there), then the Mac, the real Windows PC last. Close Live before the Virus moves.
Disposable copies only: the projects are copies; do not store patches into the Virus.
Logging on as usual (diag.on); Claude reads diag.log afterwards.

sections.title: Windows 11 VM
sections.where: win11 VM, Ableton Live 11, TI Revive 0.8.25b (done: PW1, PW2 pass, PW3 as expected)
prep: Claude attaches the Virus to the VM before you start (ask in the chat). The projects are in C:\tirevive-test\projcompat\.

items.title: Project with the original as VST3 opens with TI Revive
steps: Open C:\tirevive-test\projcompat\restore-test-vst3.als (made with the original Access plug-in, VST3, on Windows 10).
Open the plug-in window of track 1. Look at the part names, then play the clip (8 s is enough), first with the Easy page of part 1, then of part 2.
items.expect: no "plug-in missing" message; track 1 is TI Revive Virus Control; part 1 Fimplex HS, part 2 Acidia AV, part 3 Alead BC, parts 4-16 -Init-; the clip plays part 1; the Cutoff knob of part 1 follows its automation, the Reso knob of part 2 follows its own.

items.title: Save with TI Revive and reopen
steps: After PW1: File > Save Live Set As, name it restore-test-vst3-tirevive.als in the same folder, close Live.
Open that file again, check the part names and play the clip.
items.expect: the same patches on parts 1-3 and the same automation as in PW1.

items.title: Project with the original as VST2
steps: Open C:\tirevive-test\projcompat\restore-test-vst2.als (the same set-up, the original as VST2).
Write down exactly what Live shows for track 1 (message text, device name).
items.expect: probably "plug-in missing" for the VST2 "Virus TI": TI Revive is VST3 only and does not claim the VST2 id (not tested yet). Pass = you wrote down what happened; if Live replaces it with TI Revive, say so.
